## Install

**HACS (recommended)** — HACS offers this version as an update. New install: [add the repository](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=vokomarov&repository=hass-livoltek-portal&category=integration), download, restart Home Assistant.

**Manual** — download `livoltek_portal.zip` below and unpack it into `config/custom_components/livoltek_portal/`, then restart Home Assistant.

## Documentation

[Installation](https://github.com/vokomarov/hass-livoltek-portal/blob/main/docs/installation.md) · [Configuration](https://github.com/vokomarov/hass-livoltek-portal/blob/main/docs/configuration.md) · [Entities](https://github.com/vokomarov/hass-livoltek-portal/blob/main/docs/entities.md) · [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/vokomarov/hass-livoltek-portal/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)

Anything that changes a unit, a state class, or an entity id is called out in the notes above — those are the changes that can disturb existing statistics and automations.
